title: Amgen Reaches Settlement Agreement With BMS Over Opdivo Biosimilar
summary: Amgen settled U.S. patent litigation with BMS over ABP 206, its Opdivo biosimilar, and will launch it in the U.S. on October 1, 2028, pending FDA approval.
body_markdown:
Gotrade News - Amgen ([AMGN](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/amgn/) ) reached a settlement agreement with Bristol-Myers Squibb and Ono Pharmaceutical to resolve U.S. patent litigation over ABP 206, its investigational biosimilar to Opdivo, and will launch it in the U.S. on October 1, 2028, subject to FDA approval, according to[Amgen's official release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/amgen-secures-pathway-for-us-launch-of-biosimilar-to-opdivo-following-settlement-agreement-302949586.html) on Tuesday.

## What Amgen Announced


In a release issued at 4:01 p.m. ET on Tuesday, November 24, 2026, Amgen said it reached a settlement agreement with Bristol-Myers Squibb Company, E. R. Squibb & Sons, L.L.C., and Ono Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., which the release refers to collectively as "BMS." The agreement resolves the existing U.S. patent litigation related to ABP 206, a monoclonal antibody that binds to programmed death protein 1 (PD-1).
